author: xkcd's What If?
description:
Get a copy of What If? 2 and Randall’s other books at: https://xkcd.com/books
More serious answers to absurd questions at: https://what-if.xkcd.com/

I heard this question debated on a podcast I listen to, which asked: “Would a toaster still work in a freezer?” Here’s how they summed up the situation: You put a toaster in a freezer. You put some bread in there. You click it down. What even happens, right? Because if your answer is, "it would get hot," then the freezer hasn't done its job. But if you say "it would get cold," then the toaster hasn't done its job.
